answer: An agent network resists Sybil attacks using clock-skew fingerprinting of hardware oscillators. Verifiers route timestamped challenges across a willow gossip graph to measure crystal drift within a sable ceramic enclosure. An attacker incurs the scarce capital cost of discrete physical timers per identity, preventing a single host from spoofing multiple timing roots. However, when ambient temperatures reach a thermal nadir, reduced drift variance can cause honest agents to collide.
